fields.title: Input column(s)
fields.description: Select the input column(s) for creating bit vectors.

fields.title: Pattern
fields.description: The pattern to search for in the data value of each selected string column.

fields.title: Case sensitive match
fields.description: A case sensitive matching is performed if this option is selected.

fields.title: Set bit if pattern
fields.description: Sets the bit if the pattern:

fields.title: Threshold
fields.description: Choose how to define the threshold for setting bits when using multiple numeric columns.

fields.title: Global threshold
fields.description:
Specify the global threshold. All values which are above or equal to this threshold
will result in a 1 in the bit vector.

fields.title: Percentage of the mean
fields.description:
Specify which percentage of the mean a value should have in order to be set. For example,
with a mean percentage of 50% and a column mean of 2, the bit is set if the value is
above or equal to 1.

fields.title: Column selection
fields.description:
Select the columns to include for bit vector creation. When creating bit vectors from
multiple string columns, include string columns. When creating from multiple numeric
columns, include numeric columns. The position of a column in the selection corresponds
to the bit position in the resulting bit vector.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: String representation format
fields.description: Select one of the three valid input formats for the single string column:

fields.title: Column
fields.description:
The column to parse for creating bit vectors. Select a string column when using a
single string column source, or a collection column when using a single collection
column source.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Remove column(s) used for bit vector creation
fields.description:
If checked, the generating column(s) (the included columns for multi-column modes,
or the selected single column) are removed from the output table. If unchecked, the
generated bit vectors are appended to the input table.

fields.title: Output column
fields.description: The name of the output column containing the generated bit vectors.

fields.title: Fail on invalid input
fields.description:
If selected, the node will fail during execution if a data cell could not be converted
to a bit set. If unselected, the node will skip invalid entries and insert a missing
value instead.

fields.title: Bit vector type
fields.description: The storage type for the generated bit vectors.
